post.description: Start a project from dropped BOQ files. Without a name, it is named after the first file.
Add more BOQ files to a project. A file the project already has is ignored.

put.description: The engineer sets a sheet's columns. Its items are read again from the cells; the AI leaves it as it is.

post.description: The engineer says a page lists no items.

get.description: A page's content. Sheets come a window of rows at a time, from row `start`.

schema.title: Response Get Page Projects  Project Id  Sources  Source Id  Pages  Number  Get

get.description: A PNG of a PDF page or an image; drawn once, then kept beside the page's content.

post.description: Stop the running step; the project waits until the engineer continues.
A stopped or paused project carries on from where it is.

Run a step again with the engineer's note: read a file (or one page) again, or place again what the AI
placed (in one package, or everywhere). The engineer's own placements stay.
Show the publish card again, to publish the current work (again, for instance without rates).
Carry out the engineer's answer. Approving publishing writes the revision before the answer is kept.

get.description: Items in use, in file order: all of them, one package's, or those not placed yet.

delete.description: Remove a package; its items wait to be placed again.

post.description: Merge other packages into this one; their items keep their placement reasons.
The engineer puts items in a package. It settles any question raised about them.

get.description: Rules the engineer chose to apply to every project.

Keep a key only once it works. An OpenAI-compatible service may not list its models; for those, the model
check proves the key. Codex is kept once it is installed and signed in; there is only ever one.
